pages.en:
Enquiry into 30/12/30

Whereas, Lee San Phue states
that he is the real owner of
the woman, & during his temporary
absence in Nanking he had asked
C.D.S. 62 to keep an eye on her.
He returned to Shanghai yesterday
and expresses regret at the trouble
caused by the woman, especially
as it has brought discredit on
C.D.S. 62 ! The matter of the
housing house after has been
squared up.
= The woman is still absent
from Shanghai.
= The housing house people
do not wish any action to be
taken.
pages.zh:
关于1930年12月30日的查询

鉴于李三辉（Lee San Phue，音译）声称
他是该女子的真正主人，且在他临时
前往南京期间，他曾要求
华捕62号代为照看她。
他于昨日返回上海，并对该女子
引起的麻烦表示遗憾，特别是
此事已使华捕62号蒙羞！此后，
关于妓院一事已得到解决。
= 该女子仍不在上海。
= 妓院方面不希望
采取任何行动。

pages.en:
I think I am of the
opinion that 38 & 62 have
perhaps more than a
"protective" interest in the
land, i.e. the statement of the
title. For some time ago
him + I was strongly warned
him to keep an eye on it
his matter if he wishes to
continue in the Civil Service
+ not very distant in the
future.

30 DEC. 1930
pages.zh:
我认为，38号与62号
对该地产或许拥有超出
“保护性”利益之外的权益，
即产权声明所述之权益。前一段时间，
我与他曾强烈警告他，若他希望
继续在警务部门任职，且在
不远的将来，务必留心
此事。

1930年12月30日
